title: Transporter
description: The one mobile Thing of the shopfloor. It moves one unit at a time and carries at most one product, which it picks up where it stands.

carrying.title: The product being carried, or false while the transporter is empty

capacity.title: How many products may be carried at once

pickup.title: pick a product up
pickup.description: Take the given product, but only while the transporter carries nothing and stands on the product's position.

input.title: product
input.description: The Thing Description of the product to pick up.

drop.title: drop any carried product
drop.description: Put down whatever the transporter carries, at its current position.

moveLeft.title: move transporter left
moveLeft.description: Move one unit left along the x axis. A product the transporter carries moves with it; writing through 'carrying' has no effect while nothing is carried.

moveRight.title: move transporter right
moveRight.description: Move one unit right along the x axis. A product the transporter carries moves with it; writing through 'carrying' has no effect while nothing is carried.

moveUp.title: move transporter up
moveUp.description: Move one unit up along the y axis. A product the transporter carries moves with it; writing through 'carrying' has no effect while nothing is carried.

moveDown.title: move transporter down
moveDown.description: Move one unit down along the y axis. A product the transporter carries moves with it; writing through 'carrying' has no effect while nothing is carried.
